title: SiteShrimp Photo Entry — Facilities Management variant
description: Variant for in-operation building / facilities-management defect capture. Different from contractual-defect inspection: the asset is in service, the defect goes to a maintenance ticket (preventive vs reactive), and the SLA window matters for owner / occupier reporting.

service_category.description: Primary FM service line the defect falls under. Routes to the right maintenance contractor / in-house team. Required — every FM-frame photo has an identifiable service line.

maintenance_type.description: Maintenance lifecycle stage. Drives ticket prioritisation and SLA expectation.

asset_id.description: FM asset register reference (free text — owners use varied conventions). Empty when the photo isn't tied to a tagged asset.
